name: contract-contract-only
goal: Contract tabs show API facts only and never list verification states; states remain available in the dedicated verification views.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The explorer feature specification now distinguishes API and category facts from verification states, which remain on dedicated States/Tests/evidence views.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: RED: bun run test:unit -- test/utils/entity-contract.test.ts test/utils/entity-shown.test.ts test/components/entity-details.test.ts test/components/entity-overview.test.ts failed as expected: 7 contract-state assertions failed across 4 files; 33 unrelated assertions passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Removed verification state fields from ContractFacts and from entityContract rows; entityShown no longer injects states into contract data. Updated the explorer feature criteria and registered function/component contract descriptions to keep state coverage on evidence views.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: GREEN: repeated bun run test:unit -- test/utils/entity-contract.test.ts test/utils/entity-shown.test.ts test/components/entity-details.test.ts test/components/entity-overview.test.ts; 4 files and 37 tests passed, including the no-states Contract assertions and States-tab coverage.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Focused reports unit tests: 37 passed; reports Svelte typecheck: 0 errors and 0 warnings; targeted Playwright contract/states tab test: 1 passed with inspected screenshot at /tmp/harness-contract-no-states-shots/component-contract-without-states-desktop.png; targeted Prettier and Harness app audit passed. Full CLI suite omitted as requested.
